author: Inside Edition
description: An Amazon delivery driver walked up to the front door of a home to drop off a package before taking the family cat who was wandering on the property. He walked off the property with the cat in his arms in Bakersfield, California. Brenda Wilson says she was in disbelief watching as the family cat named Junnie was taken. The driver has been identified as Joshua Gonzalez . He has not been charged with a crime. Gonzalez claims that the cat is actually his.
title: Amazon Delivery Driver Takes Cat From Outside Of Home, Claims The Cat Is His

author: Inside Edition
description: A parade of A-listers gathered in Chicago for the opening of the Obama Presidential Center on Thursday. The Clintons, Bushs, Bidens and the Obamas, were there. Attendees were serenaded by Jennifer Hudson, Christina Aguilera, Bruce Springsteen, John Legend, and Bono. The center, which opens officially Friday, has gotten mixed reviews. President Donald Trump has been trashing the center. Trump is planning to one-up Former President Barack Obama with a presidential center twice as high.
title: A-Listers Gather For Opening Of Obama Presidential Center

author: Inside Edition
description: Descending into the ocean while parasailing, high school friends Natalia Disora and Mason Guyer spotted a shark right below. Seconds from splashing down, the good humored pals could not believe the pickle they were in. Inside Edition's Alison Hall spoke with the chuckling friends about their scary encounter in Ocean City, Maryland.
title: Parasailing Friends Laugh As They Descend Into Ocean And See A Shark Below Them

author: Inside Edition
description: A video of a father taking his two daughters into the women's restroom is going viral. A man who said his wife and mother-in-law needed to use the bathroom called 911 and the confrontation continued after the father left the bathroom. Dad Tyler Brodsky says the incident happened at a rest stop during a family road trip from Florida to Oklahoma. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian spoke with Brodsky. Brodsky says police arrived and were supportive of him. Inside Edition spoke with parenting expert Lyss Stern.
title: Father Taking Young Daughters To Women's Bathroom Causes Uproar

author: Inside Edition
description: A Clark County Sheriff's deputy stepped in to help when a baby was left inside a vehicle on a 92-degree day. Witnesses first alerted law enforcement to the situation. They created shade around the car while Deputy Hulsey got the okay from his sergeant. The Clark County Sheriff's Department say the boy was in the car for 16 minutes. The parents were located at a nearby grocery store, where they said they'd been for almost 30 minutes. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Police Rescue Toddler From Car On 92-Degree Day

author: Inside Edition
description: Former child star Daveigh Chase has died. The actor's boyfriend, Roy Hernandez, told TMZ that she died Tuesday from meningitis and a blood infection. She had been admitted to the hospital earlier this month for malnutrition. Chase may be best known for voicing Lilo in the 2002 animated hit "Lilo and Stitch." She also played Lilo in the film's sequel, and appeared as a terrifying evil presence in 2002's "The Ring." Daveigh Chase was 35 years old.
title: 'Lilo And Stitch' Star Daveigh Chase Has Died

author: Inside Edition
description: When humans eat loudly, it's unpleasant. When baby animals do it, it's adorable. In preparation for the upcoming Dragon Boat Festival, Yunnan Wildlife Park in southwest China prepared a feast for their resident tiger and black bear cubs. Zongzis are sticky rice dumplings, filled and wrapped in leaves. And each species got a meal tailored to their dietary preferences. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Tiger Cub Thinks It's Roaring
